Institution name codes.

first Seat (a swap).

The «Fordeling» block: the registered Students now, those of them not in the draft (they
registered after it was drawn), and the draft, None until one is drawn.

One Seat of a Class game in the draft (Story 5.8). `user_id` None is an empty Seat (an AI

page.

One id the action touched: its key in the row (`user_id`, `invitation_id`, …) and what the
owning module calls it now; `label` is null when no module knows it.

BillOut.description:
The Debrief's extra lines under Kjedens regning (Story 9.8, FR-44, UX-DR36), every number

over tid are the game result's (`/api/me/games/{id}/result`, Story 6.18).

BounceClass.description:
Why a mail did not reach its address: `hard` the provider calls permanent (the address
does not exist or refuses mail), `soft` every other bounce (a full mailbox, a server down).

The registration status of an address whose Invitation bounced; Story 4.7 lists it with
the other statuses.

ChainOut.description:
Step 3, the whole chain (Story 9.5, FR-44, UX-DR33, UX-DR34): all four Roles, Fabrikk
first (upstream first, the order the Ordrestolper rows and the scrubber's reading take), each
with every logged Uke, oldest first. Every number is the api's (AD-10).
ChainOut.title: ChainOut

ChainRoleOut.description:
One Role of the whole chain: every Uke, and from the stored facts set (Story 9.1, AD-7) its
Forsterkning and the first Uke with an Order of `large_order` or more.
ChainRoleOut.title: ChainRoleOut

ChainWeekCost.description: The chain's cost from Uke 1 through `week`, summed over its Roles.
ChainWeekCost.title: ChainWeekCost

ChainWeekOut.description:
One Uke of one Role in the whole chain (Story 9.5): its Order and the Week state it saw
when it ordered (the Decision log's `state_seen`, as the play screen showed it).
ChainWeekOut.title: ChainWeekOut

Choice.description: The answers to «Har du spilt et spill som ligner dette før?»; `skipped` is «Hopp over».
Choice.title: Choice

ClassCostOut.description:
«Klassens kostnad» (Story 7.6, FR-39, AD-10): over the finished Class games, the median and
quartiles of their chain costs for the Kostnadsfordeling, the chain's mean lager and restordre
per game and each Role's mean, Detaljist first. Computed by `analysis.class_cost`.
ClassCostOut.title: ClassCostOut

ClassIn.description:
A new Class (Story 4.1). The service checks the fields and answers every refused one in
`fields`: `name`, `institution_id` (`institution_missing`, `institution_unknown`) and
`course_code`.
ClassIn.title: ClassIn

ClassListItem.description: One Class on the Lærerhjem: «Klassene dine».
ClassListItem.title: ClassListItem

ClassListOut.description: The Classes the User is staff of, by name. No paging: a Lecturer has a handful.
ClassListOut.title: ClassListOut

ClassOut.description: One Class with its Institution's name and the User's staff role in it.
ClassOut.title: ClassOut

ClassOverviewOut.description:
The Oversikt of a Class session (Story 7.1, FR-39, AD-25): its Class games in the list
envelope, by game number, the headline counts and the database clock (`server_now`).
ClassOverviewOut.title: ClassOverviewOut

ClassSessionListOut.description: The Class sessions of one Class, newest first. No paging: a Class has a handful.
ClassSessionListOut.title: ClassSessionListOut

ClassSessionOut.description: One Class session as its Class's staff read it.
ClassSessionOut.title: ClassSessionOut

ClassSessionSaveIn.description:
«Lagre Klasseøkt». The screen sends the AI mode, Effort level and Debrief mode as chosen
(Story 5.5), the four dates (Story 5.2) and the Game settings (Story 5.3) with the Demand
pattern and its seed (Story 5.4), and the obligatory mark, its required share and the
Inactivity limit (Story 5.7); a field left out keeps its value. `game_settings` is laid over
the stored settings, so a setting left out keeps its value. With Rule-based players no Effort
level is in force, and a sent one is ignored.
ClassSessionSaveIn.title: ClassSessionSaveIn

CopiedFromOut.description: The source of a copied Class session, as the Klasseøkt names it.
CopiedFromOut.title: CopiedFromOut

CopyIn.description:
«Lag kopi» (Story 5.18, FR-66): the Class session to copy, and whether to keep its demand
seed (a fresh one is drawn otherwise).
CopyIn.title: CopyIn

CopySourceListOut.description: The Class sessions a rerun may copy, newest first. No paging: a Lecturer has a handful.
CopySourceListOut.title: CopySourceListOut

CopySourceOut.description: A Class session the Lecturer may copy: one of a Class they are staff of.
CopySourceOut.title: CopySourceOut

CostLine.description: One part of this Week's cost: units on the end-of-Week balance times the rate.
CostLine.title: CostLine

CostSum.description: Holding and backlog cost and their sum, in kroner (Story 6.18).
CostSum.title: CostSum

DatesIn.description: The four dates as the Lecturer set them, each an instant with its offset or None.
DatesIn.title: DatesIn

DebriefMode.description: How the Debrief is held (FR-16): the four of a Class game together, or each alone.
DebriefMode.title: DebriefMode

DebriefOut.description:
The Student's Debrief session: its id (the `debrief:<id>` topic, AD-8), the game it
reviews and the step pointer. Never the demand series, the number of Weeks or another
Seat's numbers (FR-14): those come with the steps that reveal them, after the Explanation.
DebriefOut.title: DebriefOut

DebriefRelease.description:
When the Debriefs open (Story 9.2, FR-42): `open`, each Student's once their own Class
game has finished (the default; it can reveal the Demand pattern to Students still playing),
or `hold`, every Debrief once all Class games have finished.
DebriefRelease.title: DebriefRelease

DebriefStepOut.description:
A Debrief step after step 1, reached only with a saved Explanation (FR-41, FR-43). Step 2
carries the reveal (Story 9.4), step 3 the whole chain (Story 9.5), step 4 the own moments
(Story 9.7) and the Debrief's lines under Kjedens regning (Story 9.8); step 5, the Debrief quiz,
has routes of its own (`/quiz`, Story 9.9) and answers the step number only here.
DebriefStepOut.title: DebriefStepOut

DemandFixed.description: A fixed series: `values[w - 1]` is the demand in Week w.
DemandFixed.title: DemandFixed

DemandRandom.description: Discrete uniform demand over `mean - spread` to `mean + spread`, never below 0.
DemandRandom.title: DemandRandom

DemandSeriesOut.description:
The customer demand of Weeks 1 to the last, as the engine materialises it from the stored
Demand pattern and seed (Story 5.4, FR-13): `demand[w - 1]` is the demand in Week w. For the
Class's staff only; no Student-facing answer carries it (AD-3).
DemandSeriesOut.title: DemandSeriesOut

DemandStep.description: Customer demand `start` until `change_week`, then `new_level` from that Week on.
DemandStep.title: DemandStep

DemandStepNoise.description: A step in the mean with discrete uniform noise of `spread` around it.
DemandStepNoise.title: DemandStepNoise

EnrolledClassListOut.description: The Classes the User is a Student in, by name. No paging: a Student has a handful.
EnrolledClassListOut.title: EnrolledClassListOut

EnrolledClassOut.description: A Class the User is a Student in (Story 4.5): what Hjem names.
EnrolledClassOut.title: EnrolledClassOut

EnrolledLabHourOut.description: An upcoming Lab hour as a Student reads it (Story 5.6, FR-19), for Epic 6's Hjem.
EnrolledLabHourOut.title: EnrolledLabHourOut

EnrolledSessionOut.description:
A Class session as its Student reads it (Story 5.2, FR-18, AD-3): the dates and the next
deadline that applies. Never the Game settings, the number of Weeks or the demand.
EnrolledSessionOut.title: EnrolledSessionOut

ExplanationIn.description:
«Send Forklaring»: the text as typed. It must hold more than white space and at most
5000 characters (422 `validation_error`).
ExplanationIn.title: ExplanationIn

ExplanationOut.description:
A stored Explanation (FR-41, AD-14): the text as typed, its length in characters and when
it was saved. Never changed after it is stored.
ExplanationOut.title: ExplanationOut

FollowUpAnswerOut.description:
A follow-up question with its answer (Story 9.15, FR-45, AD-7): `answered` carries the hint
text code rendered from the model's choice of templates and facts, marked by `ai_generated`;
`declined` (outside the Game) and `unanswered` (no answer could be given: the call failed or
its output was rejected) carry none, and the web app shows a fixed line. Only `answered` and
`declined` are stored; `asked_at` is null for `unanswered`.
FollowUpAnswerOut.title: FollowUpAnswerOut

FollowUpIn.description:
A follow-up question about the Student's own Game (Story 9.15): as typed. It must hold more
than white space and at most 500 characters (422 `validation_error`).
FollowUpIn.title: FollowUpIn

FollowUpOut.description:
The follow-up field under the reflection questions (Story 9.15, FR-45, FR-15): `off` when
the Class session's Debrief AI text is off, no provider may answer, the pinned templates hold
no hints or the Seat has no fact to point to (the field is not shown); `closed` after the
Student's Test deadline or once their Individual test has opened; else `open`. `asked` holds
the Student's own stored questions, oldest first.
FollowUpOut.title: FollowUpOut

FunnelStageOut.description: One stage of the Trakt (Story 7.6, FR-39): how many registered Students reached it.
FunnelStageOut.title: FunnelStageOut

GameInsightOut.description:
Spillinnsikt (Story 7.7, FR-62, AD-3, AD-12): one Game week by week, for the staff of its
Class only. The only answer that gives the staff the full chain, the demand series and the
number of Weeks. Seats and Roles in chain order, the Role serving the customer first.
GameInsightOut.title: GameInsightOut

GameResult.description:
A finished Game's cost (Story 6.18, FR-28): each Role's, the chain's, and the chain's
running cost per Uke. Numbers and Roles only: no names, no demand, no settings.
GameResult.title: GameResult

GameRulesOut.description:
The rules «Regler før første ordre» states (Story 6.2, FR-84), from the Class session's
frozen settings: the delays, the number of Veiledede uker and the two cost rates. Never the
number of Weeks, the demand, its seed or the largest Order (FR-14, AD-3).
GameRulesOut.title: GameRulesOut

GameSettings.description: Everything that defines a Game's arithmetic. `GameSettings()` is the Classic game.
GameSettings.title: GameSettings

GameStatus.description:
A Game's status as staff see it (FR-39), from `games.rules.game_status` only (AD-2); Epic 8
adds `paused`.
GameStatus.title: GameStatus

GameWeeksOut.description:
Every opened Week of a Class game (Story 7.2, AD-25): the Matrisevegg's cells, read
on demand per Game. The finished state after the last Week is not a Week and is left out.
GameWeeksOut.title: GameWeeksOut

GroupMemberOut.description:
A joined Student of a Group debrief as the other joined Students see them (Story 9.11,
FR-43): the Roster name now (None once no longer a Student of the Class), whether it is the
caller, whether their Explanation is sent and whether they have finished the shared step. Never
the text of their Explanation or answers.

GroupOut.description:
A Group debrief's shared step pointer (Story 9.11, FR-43): `step` 1 to 3 is shared, 4 means
each Student works alone from the reflection questions on. `move_on_at` is when the opener may
move every joined Student on (database time). `members` only for a joined caller, else
empty. Story 9.12: `opener` is whoever may move on now (the earliest-joined Student still
there once the opener has gone); `alone` says why the caller goes on as a Personal debrief
(`left`, `dropout`, `fallback`, `missed`), from shared step `alone_from`; both None
otherwise.
GroupOut.title: GroupOut

InfoVisibility.description:
Information visibility (cut list, FR-83): which neighbour each Seat sees, with its current
inventory and backlog. Both views off by default; the Factory has no upstream neighbour and
the Retailer no downstream one, so their view on that side shows nothing.

InsightLinkOut.description:
A link for one Seat's Student on Spillinnsikt (FR-62), from a provider a later module
registered (`games.service.register_insight_links`, Epic 9): `kind` names it, the page words
it; `href` is a path in the web app.

InsightSeatOut.description: A Seat of the Game on Spillinnsikt as held now, like the Oversikt's, with its links.

Week state, the Order from the Decision log, who held the Seat and its marks (AD-15).

InstitutionChoicesOut.description: The Institutions a new Class may belong to, by name («Lag Klasse»).

InstitutionListOut.description:
A page of Institutions in the list envelope, newest first: `next_cursor` is null on the

InstitutionOut.description: One Institution (Story 3.11): what the Admin's list shows and what other modules read.

IntRange.description: Every whole number from `minimum` to `maximum`, both included; one is drawn per seed.

InvitationBounce.description: A Roster address whose newest Invitation bounced, not registered and not removed.

InvitationIn.description: An Invitation to an account role (Story 3.7).
InvitationIn.title: InvitationIn

InvitationKind.description:

Student (Story 4.4), or a place in one Class's staff as Assistant lecturer (Story 4.9).

ItemResultOut.description:
The stored answer and its score. Only for an answered item: the answer key is never sent
before.
ItemResultOut.title: ItemResultOut

A Lab hour as the Lecturer adds or changes it (Story 5.6, FR-19): its start and end as

LabHourOut.description: A Lab hour as the Class's staff read it, UTC; the web app shows it in Europe/Oslo.

LargestOrderOut.description: The Student's largest Order and the first Uke they placed it («Din ordre, 24 i Uke 11»).

MessageFormOut.description: What the Meldingsskjema shows before a send (UX-DR46).

MyExplanationOut.description: The Student's own Explanation in this Debrief, or None before it is sent.

MyMessageOut.description: One Message on the Student's Hjem (Story 7.10): plain text, shown as written.

MySummaryOut.description: The Student's own Debrief summary, `summary` None until «Fullfør Debriefen».
MySummaryOut.title: MySummaryOut

NeighbourNumber.description: One number about a neighbouring Seat, labelled with its Role and the Week it refers to.
NeighbourNumber.title: NeighbourNumber

One Uke of the Student's own Netto lager (Story 9.3): inventory minus backlog as their
Seat saw it when ordering that Uke (the Decision log's `state_seen`).

OfferedEffortLevelOut.description:
An Effort level the Class session may use (Story 5.5, FR-78), as the model config holds it
and `ai.config.offered_effort_levels` offers it: nothing here is written by `sessions`.

OrderIn.description:
The Student's Order for the open Week (Story 6.12): one whole number; the command checks

OtherSeenOut.description: What another Role saw in the moment's Uke (the facts set's `others_seen`).

OverviewAiOut.description:
The AI players on the Oversikt (Story 7.6, UX-DR69): the Seats an AI player holds now and
the Class games with at least one («22 KI-spillere i 17 spill, alle merket.»).

OverviewAlertOut.description:

OverviewGameOut.description: One Class game on the Oversikt, from its `game_summaries` row (Story 7.1, AD-25).

OverviewSeatOut.description:
A Seat of a Class game on the Oversikt (Story 7.1): its Role and who holds it, a Student
by the name they have now, any AI player as «KI-spiller» (`ai`), or free.

OverviewWaitOut.description:
A Student Seat the Class game waits for (FR-25), and since when on the database clock; the

OverviewWaitOut.title: OverviewWaitOut

The play screen's one envelope (Story 6.6, AD-3): what the Student's own Seat sees in the
open Week (`seat_state`, numbers and Roles only), the own turn (`turn`, Story 6.10) and who

Seat's Order once placed (in a Guided Week the fixed Order, placed when the Week opened) and
whether the Student has opened the Guided Week. Never how many Guided Weeks there are.

A Student named by the scheduling aid (Story 6.19): the name now, and whether it is the
reader. None as name for a Student no longer in the Class.
ProposalPersonOut.title: ProposalPersonOut

QuizAttemptIn.description:
An attempt: one answer per asked question, in the order shown (422 `validation_error`
otherwise).
QuizAttemptIn.title: QuizAttemptIn

QuizAttemptOut.description:
A scored attempt (Story 9.9, FR-46): its number from 1, when it was stored, how many of the
asked questions were right and every question with its result.

at the lock, whether it is placeholder content (issue #16), the attempts so far and when it was
passed, the questions of the next attempt (the order may change between attempts; none once

One question of a scored attempt, in the order shown: the Student's choice, the right one

the Student's own Game rendered by code from the facts set of their Seat, AD-7).

«Fortsett» on a reflection question: the answer as typed. It must hold more than white
space and at most 2000 characters (422 `validation_error`).

ReflectionAnswerOut.description:
A stored reflection answer (FR-45, AD-14): as typed, its length in characters and when it
was saved. Never changed after it is stored.
ReflectionAnswerOut.title: ReflectionAnswerOut

ReflectionOut.description:
The reflection questions between steps 3 and 4 (Story 9.6, FR-45): the version the Class
session pinned at the lock, its questions in the order asked (feelings, evidence, structure),
each with the caller's own answer only (FR-43).

ReflectionQuestionOut.description: One reflection question (Story 9.6) with the Student's own answer, None until answered.
ReflectionQuestionOut.title: ReflectionQuestionOut

RegistrationOut.description:
One address on the Roster with its status. `id` names the Roster entry for a reminder to
it alone; `remindable` is whether a reminder would go to it (not registered, not a hard
bounce).
RegistrationOut.title: RegistrationOut

RegistrationStatus.description:
Where a Roster address stands, read at request time; the first that applies wins.
`registered` / `registered_manually`: a Student in the Class (stored). `renewal_requested`:
the Student asked for a new Invitation from a link that no longer works. `bounced`: the mail
of its newest Invitation did not arrive (with `bounce_class`). `invited`: its newest
Invitation still works (with `last_valid_day`). `unregistered`: its newest Invitation expired
or was voided unaccepted. `not_invited`: added by hand and sent no Invitation yet (Story
4.8).

get.description: One Class session, for the Klasseøkt screen. Its Class's Assistant lecturers read it too.

put.description:
«Lagre Klasseøkt»: saves the Class session as it stands. LLM players while no model config
is pinned as the default answer 409 `llm_unavailable`, and nothing changes.

With `dates` the four dates are replaced (FR-18). `fields` names each date in question:
422 `invalid_dates` (`past`, `order` for the later date of a pair out of order, `before` for
the earlier one when only it changed, `required` once locked), 409 `deadline_passed`
(`passed`). Dates count to the whole minute.

`effort_level`, `debrief_mode`, `debrief_release` and `debrief_ai_text` (FR-15, FR-16, FR-42,
FR-78), left out, keep their values; a changed `debrief_release` or `debrief_ai_text` once
locked answers 409 `session_locked` too. With LLM
players a changed Effort level the model config does not offer answers 422
`invalid_effort_level` (`{"effort_level": "not_offered"}`); with Rule-based players no level
is in force and a sent one is ignored. Once the Start date has passed, a changed AI mode,
Effort level or Debrief mode answers 409 `session_locked`, `fields` naming each.

With `game_settings` (the editable settings, laid over the stored ones; `demand` and
`demand_seed` too) the engine judges the settings (FR-12, FR-13): 422 `invalid_settings` with
`fields` mapping each setting (`demand.<field>` inside the Demand pattern) to
`{code, minimum, maximum, decimal_places}`. Once locked, changed settings answer 409
`session_locked` (`{"game_settings": "locked"}`).

`game_settings.capacity` (Story 5.15) is `{role: units}` or null: one Role or every Role
capped per Week, `capacity.<role>` from 1 to 100. While `FEATURE_CAPACITY` is off a
non-empty capacity answers 422 `feature_disabled` (`{"capacity": "feature_disabled"}`).

`game_settings.info_visibility` (Story 5.16) is `{upstream, downstream}`, two booleans that
let each Seat see its neighbour's inventory and backlog; anything else is `info_visibility`
`invalid`. While `FEATURE_INFO_VISIBILITY` is off a view switched on answers 422
`feature_disabled` (`{"info_visibility": "feature_disabled"}`).

`obligatory`, `required_share_percent` and `inactivity_limit_hours` (Story 5.7, FR-17,
FR-36), left out, keep their values. A changed share outside 1 to 100 or Inactivity limit
under 20 hours answers 422 `invalid_session_values` (`out_of_range`, `below_minimum`); once
locked a changed one answers 409 `session_locked`. Switching the mark on tells each
registered Student through the day's digest mail.

`allocation_method` (Story 5.17, FR-21), left out, keeps the method. `student_choice` creates
empty Class games for the registered Students and tells each of them through the day's digest
mail that they may choose a Class game and a Seat. A changed method answers 422
`feature_disabled` (`{"allocation_method": "feature_disabled"}`) for Student choice while
`FEATURE_STUDENT_CHOICE` is off, 409 `session_locked` once locked and 409
`allocation_confirmed` (`{"allocation_method": "confirmed"}`) once an allocation is confirmed:
Student choice is final once saved.

`replay_scenario` (Story 10.2, FR-49), left out, keeps the Replay scenario: `default`, or
`own` with `replay_template`, the own scenario's editable fields (`starting_inventory`,
`starting_backlog`, `supply_line`, the three delays, `weeks`, `guided_weeks`, `max_order` as
whole numbers or `{minimum, maximum}`; `holding_cost`, `backorder_cost`; `demand` as `step`
with a ranged `change_week`, `random` or `fixed`, each with a `spread`), laid over the Class
game's exact settings. A template the engine refuses answers 422 `invalid_replay_scenario`
with `fields` as `invalid_settings`; `own` with no template sent or stored names
`replay_template` `required`. Once locked, a changed scenario answers 409 `session_locked`
(`{"replay_scenario": "locked"}`).

get.description:
The «Fordeling» block (Story 5.8, FR-20): the registered Students, those not in the draft,
and the stored draft (None until one is drawn) with the Students' names read now. For the
Class's staff, Assistant lecturers too.

post.description:
Opening «Fordeling»: the stored draft unchanged, or, when none is stored, a draft drawn at
random from the registered Students in groups of four with a random Role each. With no
registered Student nothing is stored. No Game or Seat is created and no Student is told.
Once the Start date has passed a stored draft is still returned, and a draw answers 409
`session_locked` (`{"allocation": "locked"}`). An archived Class answers 409
`class_archived`.

«Bekreft fordeling» (Story 5.9, FR-20): commits the draft named by `draft_id` and
`revision`, and nothing else: one Class game per group and one Seat per Student, and each
Student is told through the day's digest mail. Pressing it again changes nothing.

409 `allocation_changed` commits no Game: `{"draft": "changed"}` when the draft is no longer
the current one (drawn again or changed), `{"draft": "students_removed"}` when Students in it
have left the Roster, whose Seats the draft now leaves free under a raised revision. 409
`session_locked` (`{"allocation": "locked"}`) once the Start date has passed; 409
`class_archived` for an archived Class.

Move a Student to a free Seat, or swap two (Story 5.10, FR-20), in the draft named by
`draft_id` and `revision`: the Student of `from_game`/`from_role` takes
`to_game`/`to_role`, and a Student there takes the first Seat. The draft keeps its id and
its revision rises by one. Once the allocation is confirmed the Class games change in the
same transaction and the Students who moved are told through the day's digest mail.

409 `allocation_changed` (`{"draft": "changed"}`) when the draft is no longer the current
one; 422 `invalid_move` with `fields` `{"to": "same"}`, `{"from"|"to": "unknown"}`,
`{"from": "empty"}` or `{"from": "last_student"}`; 409 `session_locked` (`{"allocation":
"locked"}`) once the Start date has passed; 409 `class_archived` for an archived Class.
A confirmed allocation's Games refusing the move answer the command's code (such as 409
`game_already_started`). A session with Student choice (Story 5.17) answers 409
`allocation_confirmed` (`{"allocation": "student_choice"}`). Nothing is committed on any
refusal.

«Kjør fordeling på nytt»: a new seed and a new draft under a new id, revision 1. The
refusals are those of opening it, and 409 `allocation_confirmed` (`{"allocation":
"confirmed"}`) once the allocation is confirmed.

put.description:
«Lagre quizvalg» (Story 9.10, FR-46, AD-23, AD-15): the questions to take out of the Class
session's Debrief quiz, the whole set; the others are asked. Stored as Class session rows and
recorded in the audit log; a Student who has not passed answers only the rest on their next
attempt, and one whose last attempt it now covers is told. No Student is passed by it. 409
`last_question` when no question would be asked, `test_deadline_passed` after the Class
session's Test deadline, `class_archived` for an archived Class; 422 `validation_error` for an
id the quiz does not have; 403 `forbidden` for an Assistant lecturer and every other caller.

get.description:
The customer demand Week by Week, materialised by the engine from the stored Demand
pattern and seed (FR-13, AD-1). For the Class's staff; the same settings and seed always give
the same series.

post.description:
«Legg til Labtime» (Story 5.6, FR-19): stores the Lab hour at once and tells each
registered Student through the day's digest mail. The Start-date lock does not apply.

A refusal is 422 `invalid_lab_hour` with `fields`: `place` `required` or `too_long` (over 120
characters); `ends_at` `not_after_start`, `too_long` (over 12 hours after the start) or
`past`. Times count to the whole minute.

delete.description:
Removes a Lab hour and tells each registered Student it is cancelled. A Lab hour that has
ended answers 409 `lab_hour_ended`.

put.description:
Changes a Lab hour and tells each registered Student; unchanged values tell nobody. A Lab
hour that has ended answers 409 `lab_hour_ended`; the other refusals are those of adding one
(422 `invalid_lab_hour`).

get.description:
«Meldinger» (Story 7.10): every Message of the Class session, newest first, with its
recipient, sender, time and the number of Students it went to. 403 `forbidden`, one answer,
for anyone who is not staff of the Class and for a Class session that does not exist.

post.description:
«Send Melding» (Story 7.9, FR-40, AD-9): stores the Message with one recipient row per
Student and tells each of them in the product and by e-mail. A repeat with the same `key`
answers as the first and sends nothing. 422 `message_empty`, `message_too_long` (with
`fields.max_length`) or `no_recipients`; 409 `message_key_conflict` or `class_archived`; 403
`forbidden` as the form's read.

get.description:
The Meldingsskjema's recipient (Story 7.9): its title's parts, the Students it reaches now,
the earlier Messages to it and the length limit. 403 `forbidden`, one answer, for anyone who
is not staff of the Class and for a Class session, game or Student outside it (FR-5).

The Oversikt (Story 7.1, FR-39, AD-25): every Class game of the session with its status,
Week, whom it waits for, its Seats and chain cost, the headline counts and `server_now`, read
from the maintained summaries. With an `ETag`; a request whose `If-None-Match` names it is
answered 304 with no body. 403 `forbidden` for anyone who is not staff of the Class, and for
a Class session that does not exist (FR-5, NFR-7).

The Matrisevegg's class median rows for one Veggfiltre combination (Story 7.4, AD-10,
AD-25): per Uke the median of `role`'s `cells` value with the middle half of the Games, and
the mean chain cost, over the Class games `status` matches that reached the Uke. The overview
carries no aggregates. With an `ETag` over the filter and the matched Games' versions; a
request whose `If-None-Match` names it is answered 304 before any Week is read. 403
`forbidden` for anyone who is not staff of the Class and for a Class session that does not
exist (FR-5, NFR-7).

post.description:
The engine's errors on a draft of an own Replay scenario and the warnings of changes that
probably make the Replay easier than the Class game (`replay_*` codes), as the Lecturer
leaves a field (Story 10.2, FR-12, FR-49). Stores nothing. Once locked it answers 409
`session_locked`.

The engine's errors and warnings on a draft of the Game settings, as the Lecturer leaves a
field (FR-12, AD-1). Stores nothing. Once locked it answers 409 `session_locked`.

get.description:
A Student's Explanation and Debrief summary for the Class's owners and Assistant
lecturers (Story 9.8, FR-47, AD-12), each null while not sent or not finished: the key
moments, the reflection answers, the completion time and whether it was after the Debrief
deadline. Story 9.10: the Student's Roster name now (null once they are no longer a Student
of the Class) and every Debrief quiz attempt with its time and result. 403 `forbidden` for
every other caller.

A Student's Explanation for the Class's owners and Assistant lecturers (AD-12). 404
`not_found` when the Student has not sent one; 403 `forbidden` for every other caller.

post.description:
«Start testspill» (Story 6.20, FR-87): the Lecturer plays a private test Game on the Class
session's current settings, in the chosen Role against three AI players; it starts at once.
404 `not_found` while `FEATURE_LECTURER_TEST_GAME` is off (AD-17); 409 `session_locked` from
the Start date, `test_game_running` while their last test Game here runs, `llm_unavailable`;
422 `unknown_role`; 403 `forbidden` for a session the User may not manage (FR-5).

get.description: The Classes the User is staff of, by name: «Klassene dine» on the Lærerhjem.

post.description:
Create a Class with the User as its owner (FR-6). A refused field answers 422
`invalid_request` with every refused field in `fields`, and nothing is stored.

get.description:
The Classes the User is a Student in, by name (Story 4.5): Hjem names them. Empty for a
User on no Roster.

One Class the User is a Student in. Another Class, one whose Roster no longer holds the
User's address, one that does not exist and an id that is not one all answer the same 403
`forbidden` (FR-5, FR-7).
The Institutions a new Class may belong to, by name.

One Class. A Class the User is not staff of, one that does not exist and an id that is not
one all answer the same 403 `forbidden` (FR-5).

post.description:
«Arkiver Klassen»: the Class becomes read-only and is kept until the retention period ends.
Its open Invitations stop working and its staged upload is deleted. 409 `class_archived` when
it is archived already.

get.description: The Class's sessions, newest first, for the Klasse page.

post.description:
«Lag Klasseøkt»: a Class session filled in with the Classic defaults (FR-11). When no model
config is pinned as the default, it gets Rule-based players and `llm_unavailable` says why.

«Lag kopi» (Story 5.18, FR-66): a new Class session in this Class with the Game settings,
AI mode, Effort level, Debrief mode and Inactivity limit of `source_id`, a session of any Class
the User is staff of. It takes the active default model config; an Effort level that config
does not offer becomes its default (`effort_level_replaced`). Dates, Lab hours, the Roster, the
allocation and the obligatory mark are not copied; a fresh demand seed is drawn unless
`keep_seed`. A source the User may not read answers 403 `forbidden`; copied settings the engine
refuses 422 `invalid_settings`; while `FEATURE_RERUN` is off 422 `feature_disabled`
(`{"rerun": "feature_disabled"}`).

get.description:
The Class sessions a Faglærer may copy into this Class (Story 5.18, FR-66, AD-12): every
session of every Class they are staff of, archived Classes included, newest first. While
`FEATURE_RERUN` is off it answers 422 `feature_disabled` (`{"rerun": "feature_disabled"}`).

What became of the Class's Student Invitations (Story 4.6, FR-8): how many were sent,
bounced, accepted and expired, computed now, and the Roster addresses whose newest Invitation
bounced, with the bounce's class. Its owners and Assistant lecturers may read it (Story 4.9).
A Class the User may not read, one that does not exist and an id that is not one all answer
the same 403 `forbidden`.

post.description:
«Send N Invitasjoner» (Story 4.4): write the staged upload's valid addresses to the Roster
and send each new address a Student Invitation valid through the `valid_days`-th day after
today (Europe/Oslo), in one transaction; the mails leave from `worker-batch`. 404
`not_found` when `upload_id` is not the Class's staging (sent already, replaced or expired);
422 `nothing_to_send` when no staged row is valid; 422 `invalid_request` with
`fields.valid_days` for a validity outside 1–60 days. Nothing changes on a refusal.

get.description:
«Status etter utsending» (Story 4.7, FR-9): every Roster address with its status, read now
(registered, registered manually, asked for a new Invitation, bounced with its class, invited
with its last valid day, unregistered), the totals and how many have not registered. Its
owners and Assistant lecturers may read it (Story 4.9). A Class the User may not read, one
that does not exist and an id that is not one all answer the same 403 `forbidden`.

post.description:
«Send påminnelse» (Story 4.7, FR-9, NFR-10): a new Invitation valid through the
`valid_days`-th day after today (Europe/Oslo) to every address that has not registered, or
with `roster_entry_id` to that one alone; their old links stop working. Addresses whose last
mail bounced hard are left out and named in `left_out`. 422 `nothing_to_send` when nothing
would be sent or left out (all registered, or the entry is registered or not on the Roster);
422 `invalid_request` with `fields.valid_days` for a validity outside 1–60 days.

«Lim inn adresser i stedet» (Story 4.3): split the text on line breaks, commas, semicolons
and whitespace and stage the pieces as one-column rows, replacing any earlier staged upload;
`Navn <adresse>` is read as the address. Text over the size limit or with more addresses than
the row limit answers 422 `roster_paste_too_long` and stages nothing.

delete.description: «Bytt fil»: delete the Class's staged upload. 204 whether or not there was one.

get.description:
The Class's staged upload, evaluated against its chosen column; `upload` is null when
there is none or it has expired.

post.description:
Read a Roster file (.xlsx or .csv) in memory and stage its rows for the Class, replacing
any earlier staged upload. A file that cannot be used answers 422 `roster_unreadable` and
stages nothing (the earlier staged upload stays).

put.description:
Choose the e-mail column; the staged rows are evaluated against it at once, from the staged
cells. 404 `not_found` when nothing is staged (or it expired); 422 `invalid_request` with
`fields.column = column_unknown` for a column the file does not have.

post.description:
«Legg til adresse» (Story 4.8): one address on the Roster, checked as an upload's are, with
no Invitation yet (`not_invited`; a reminder sends the first). A removed address is put back
as it was, and a registered Student has access again. 422 `invalid_request` with
`fields.email` = an address problem or `on_roster`.

delete.description:
Take an address off the Roster (Story 4.8, FR-7): its open Invitation stops working and a
registered Student loses access to the Class from their next request; the account and other
Classes stay. 404 `not_found` when the entry is not on the Class's Roster (or no entry id).

post.description:
«Registrer manuelt» (Story 4.8, FR-9): the address's User (created without a password, or
the existing one) is a Student in the Class at once, registered manually, and is mailed a
single-use link to set a password when it has none. 422 `invalid_request` with
`fields.email` (an address problem or `already_registered`) or `fields.name`.

get.description:
«Faglærere og assistenter»: the Class's Faglærere (owners) and Assistenter, each with a
status (active, invited with the last valid day, or expired).

post.description:
«Inviter Assistent»: an Invitation for this Class only, valid through the 14th day after
today (Europe/Oslo), mailed from `worker-batch`; an open one to the address is voided. 422
`invalid_request` with `fields.email` = an address problem or `already_staff`.

delete.description:
Withdraw an Assistant Invitation that is not accepted: its link stops working. 404
`not_found` when the Class has no such open Invitation.

post.description:
«Legg til Faglærer»: a User who already has the Lecturer role becomes co-owner, with the
owner's rights. 422 `invalid_request` with `fields.email` = an address problem,
`not_lecturer` (no such Lecturer; nothing about the account is told) or `already_staff`.

delete.description:
Take a Faglærer or an Assistant off the Class: their access ends from their next request.
422 `last_owner` for the Class's last Faglærer; 404 `not_found` when the User is not staff of
the Class.

get.description:
The Student's own Debrief session by id. 403 `debrief_not_open`, `debrief_held` or
`forbidden`, as above.
The Student's own Explanation, `explanation` null before it is sent.

post.description:
«Send Forklaring» (FR-41): stores the Explanation once, as typed, and records the
`explanation` step. 409 `explanation_exists` when it is sent already (unchanged), 422
`validation_error` for white space only or more than 5000 characters.

«Fullfør Debriefen» (Story 9.8, FR-47, AD-16): stores the Student's Debrief summary once
(the key moments by fact id, the reflection answers, the facts set they cite and the time)
and records the `debrief` step with it; a finished Debrief answers its stored summary
unchanged. 409 `debrief_incomplete` while a reflection question is unanswered or step 4 was
not read, 409 `test_deadline_passed` after the Student's Test deadline, 403
`explanation_required` before the Explanation.

get.description:
The follow-up field under the reflection questions (Story 9.15, FR-45, FR-15): `off` (not
shown: the Class session's Debrief AI text is off or no model may answer), `open` or `closed`,
with the Student's own questions and answers, never another Student's. 403
`reflection_required` until every reflection question is answered, `explanation_required`
before the Explanation.

post.description:
A follow-up question about the Student's own Game (Story 9.15, FR-45, AD-6, AD-7): one
model call with the question scrubbed against the Roster, answered with hints that point to
the Student's own numbers (`answered`, marked by `ai_generated`), a decline for a question
outside the Game (`declined`), or `unanswered` when no answer could be given (nothing
stored; ask again). 409 `follow_up_off`, `follow_up_closed` (closed, or the Test deadline has
passed), 422 `validation_error` (empty, over 500 characters), 429 `rate_limited` with
`retry_after` seconds, 403 `reflection_required` before the reflection questions are
answered.

«Bli med» (Story 9.11, FR-43): the Student joins the Group debrief of their own game; a
second join changes nothing. 409 `not_group` on a Personal debrief; 403 `forbidden` for anyone
whose game it is not. Story 9.12: 409 `group_closed` for a Student who goes on alone, or
after the 48-hour fallback.

«Forlat gruppen» / «Ta en Personlig debrief» (Story 9.12, FR-43): the Student goes on as a
Personal debrief from the shared step they were on, keeping what they saved; final. The group
no longer waits for them, and when they were the opener the earliest-joined Student still
there may move on. Changes nothing once the shared steps are over. 409 `not_group` on a
Personal debrief; 403 `forbidden` for anyone whose game it is not.

«Gå videre for alle» (Story 9.11, FR-43): the opener moves every joined Student to the next
step once the current one has been open the minimum wait (configuration). 409 `too_early`
with `fields.available_at` before then, `not_group` on a Personal debrief; 403 `forbidden`
for anyone but the opener.

get.description:
«Ditt netto lager, hele spillet» (Story 9.3, step 1): the Netto lager of the Student's own
Seat in every Uke, oldest first. Never demand or another Seat (FR-14).

Step 5, the Debrief quiz (Story 9.9, FR-46): the version the Class session pinned, the
questions of the Student's next attempt without the answer key (none once passed; the order
may change between attempts), the number of attempts, when it was passed and the latest
attempt's result. 403 `debrief_required` until the Student has finished the Debrief.

post.description:
An attempt at the Debrief quiz (Story 9.9, FR-46, AD-16): scored by the answer key on the
server and stored once, with each question's result and, for a wrong answer, the explanation;
every question right records the `quiz_passed` step. Retries are unlimited until the Test
deadline. 422 `validation_error` unless every asked question is answered once with one of
its choices, 409 `quiz_passed` once passed, 409 `test_deadline_passed` after the Student's
Test deadline, 403 `debrief_required` before the Debrief is finished.

get.description:
The reflection questions between steps 3 and 4 (Story 9.6, FR-45): the Class session's
pinned version, feelings, then evidence, then structure, each with the Student's own answer
(null until answered); never another Student's (FR-43). 403 `explanation_required` until the
Explanation is saved.

post.description:
«Fortsett»: stores the Student's answer to one reflection question once, as typed, and
answers the question with it. The questions are answered in order: any other than the first
unanswered one is 409 `reflection_out_of_order`; an answered one answers its stored answer
unchanged. 404 `not_found` for an id not in the pinned version, 422 `validation_error` for
white space only or more than 2000 characters, 403 `explanation_required` before the
Explanation.

get.description:
«Delt skjerm: hele kjeden» (Story 9.13, FR-74, AD-21): a Group debrief's shared charts by
Role, for a Student joined to it: every Role's Uker, Netto lager and cost, Fabrikk first, and
the chain's cost. Never a name, a user id, an Explanation, an answer or a moment. `locked` with
no chain data while a joined Student has not sent their Explanation. Anyone not joined to it
(a Personal debrief, a Student who goes on alone, an id that is not one) gets the same 403
`forbidden`.

A Debrief step after step 1 (FR-41, FR-43): 403 `explanation_required` until the Student's
Explanation is saved, checked here and not only in the web app. Step 2 carries `reveal`: the
heading rendered from the demand series and Kundene, Ordre inn and Din ordre per Uke of the
Student's own Seat (Story 9.4, FR-44). Step 3 carries `chain`: every Role's Orders and Week
states, Fabrikk first, with Forsterkning and the first large Order from the stored facts set
(Story 9.5, FR-44, AD-7). Step 4 carries `moments`: the Student's own moments rendered by
code from their Seat's stored facts set, whose id is recorded at the first view (Story 9.7,
FR-44, AD-7); none and `mostly_ai` with fewer than 10 own Orders. Only the caller's own Seat:
no route serves another Student's moments (FR-43).

The Student's own Debrief summary (Story 9.8), `summary` null until «Fullfør Debriefen».
403 `explanation_required` before the Explanation.

The live event stream (AD-8): `ready`, then `{topic, id, version}` for each change the
User may see, and `heartbeat` every 15 s. 401 without a valid session.

Spillinnsikt (Story 7.7, FR-62, AD-3, AD-12): one Class game week by week for the staff of
its Class — per Role and opened Week the incoming order and delivery, inventory, backlog,
Order and cost as stored, who held the Seat and its marks (AD-15), the Seats with their link
slots, the customer demand series and the number of Weeks. With an `ETag`; a request whose
`If-None-Match` names it is answered 304. 403 `forbidden`, one answer, for anyone who is not
staff of the Game's Class, a Student included, and for a Game that does not exist or that
the Oversikt does not list (FR-5, NFR-7).

Every opened Week of a Class game (Story 7.2, FR-39, AD-1, AD-25): per Week and Role the
Netto lager, the Order and the Kost per uke as the engine stored them, for the Matrisevegg.
The `ETag` is tied to the Game's `version`; a request whose `If-None-Match` names it is
answered 304 before any Week is read. 403 `forbidden` for anyone who is not staff of the
Game's Class, and for a Game that does not exist or that the Oversikt does not list (FR-5).

The Lærerhjem's «Venter» and «Neste frist» over the User's Classes that are not archived
(UX-DR56).

The Class sessions of the Classes the User is a Student in: dates and the next deadline,
never the Game settings (FR-18). Empty for a User who is no Student.

post.description:
Opens the Student's Debrief in the Class session (FR-42): the Debrief session of their
game, created with its step pointer at step 1 if none exists, and answered as it stands.
403 `debrief_not_open`, `debrief_held` or `forbidden`.

«Start Replay» (Story 10.3, FR-48): the Student's one Replay in the Class session, made in
the Role of their own game against three AI players and started at once; 201 with the new
Game, 200 with the one they have already (also when two starts run at once). 403
`quiz_required` before the Debrief quiz is passed, 409 `test_deadline_passed` after the
Student's Test deadline, 403 `forbidden` for any session that is not theirs (FR-5).

get.description:
«Velg spill og sete» (Story 5.17, FR-21, UX-DR62): the Class session's Class games, each
Seat free, held by a Student (named) or, after the lock, by an AI player, and the reader's own
Seat. 404 `not_found` while `FEATURE_STUDENT_CHOICE` is off, for a session that does not use
Student choice, and for a User who is not a registered Student of its Class (AD-17).

put.description:
«Ta setet Grossist i Spill 17» (Story 5.17, FR-21): the Student takes the free Seat, or
moves to it from the Seat they hold, in one request; their own Seat again changes nothing.
409 `seat_taken` (`{"seat": "taken"}`) when another occupant holds it, 422 `invalid_seat`
(`{"seat": "unknown"}`) for a game or Role the session does not have, 409 `session_locked`
(`{"seat": "locked"}`) once locked, 409 `class_archived` for an archived Class; nothing changes
then. Not found as the read.

get.description:
The Student's own Class game (Story 6.1): number, Role and the four Seats, from the Start
date. Any other game, one that does not exist and an id that is not one all answer the same
403 `forbidden`, which never says whether the game exists (FR-5).

The play screen's one envelope (Story 6.6, AD-3): `seat_state`, what the Student's own Seat
sees in the open Week (numbers and Roles only), `table_status`, who sits where, and the
server's clock. Never the number of Weeks, future demand, another Seat's numbers or a
reference Order (FR-14, FR-23). 409 `game_not_running` before the start and after the end;
any other game answers 403 `forbidden` (FR-5).

«Spillet er ferdig» (Story 6.18, FR-28, AD-3): the chain's cost per Role, Detaljist to
Fabrikk, and per Uke, once the game has finished. Roles, never names, and no demand series.
409 `game_not_finished` before the end, so no chain number leaks during play (FR-14); any
other game answers 403 `forbidden` (FR-5).

post.description:
«Start spillet» (Story 6.5, FR-22): the Student starts their own Class game for all four
Seats and gets the game as it now stands. A game already started counts as done. 409
`starting_task_required` before the Starting task is done, 409 `game_not_ready` before the
lock has given the game its snapshot; any other game answers 403 `forbidden` (FR-5).

get.description:
The Student's Starting task: the items in order, each answered one with its result, the
final question's choice and whether the task is done.

post.description:
Send the answer to one item: scored by computed rules and stored once (a repeat keeps
the first answer). 422 `unknown_item` for an item the task does not have.

Answer or skip the final question; the task is then done and `starting_task` recorded.
409 `items_open` while an item has no answer.

«Send forslaget til gruppen» (Story 6.19, FR-22): the Student proposes a time to play, a
date and a time and nothing else. It replaces the game's open proposal and its acceptances,
and each other Student of the game is told. Answers the game as it now stands. 422
`time_out_of_range` unless the time lies after now and not after the Play deadline; 409
`game_finished`; any other game, or a Seat the Student no longer holds, answers 403
`forbidden` (FR-5).

«Godta tidspunktet» (Story 6.19, FR-22): the Student accepts the game's open proposal with
one press; an acceptance already stored counts as done. Answers the game as it now stands.
409 `proposal_gone` (replaced, or its time has passed), `own_proposal` or `game_finished`;
any other game, or a Seat the Student no longer holds, answers 403 `forbidden` (FR-5).

«Bekreft ordre på 24» (Story 6.12, FR-24, AD-2): the Student's Order for the open Week of
their own Seat, placed once through `games.commands.place_order` with the Student as actor;
the client sends no `version`. 409 `order_exists` (also in a Guided Week, whose fixed Order
is placed when it opens), `week_not_open`, `game_not_started`, `game_finished` or
`seat_not_yours` (the Seat changed hands between the ownership check and the write); 422
`order_invalid` (not a whole number from 0 to the maximum). Any other game, or a Seat the
Student no longer holds, answers 403 `forbidden` (FR-5).

The Student has the Guided Week `week` on screen (Story 6.10, FR-24): it counts as their
Order there, and the view that leaves no Student to wait for opens the next Week. 204 also
when the Week was viewed already. 409 `week_not_open` (the game has moved on),
`week_not_guided`, `game_not_started`, `game_finished` or `seat_not_student`; any other
game, or a Seat the Student no longer holds, answers 403 `forbidden` (FR-5).

get.description:
The Messages written to the User, newest first (Story 7.10, FR-40, FR-73): only those
addressed to them in a Class they are a Student in (AD-12). Read-only: there is no route by
which a Student writes, replies to or forwards a Message.
